abstract: Evaluates shipboard wet laboratories and artifact conservation facilities
system_message:
You are the Marine artifact conservator (CONS), responsible for evaluating shipboard wet laboratories and artifact conservation facilities as well as assessing refrigerated artifact holding capacities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates shipboard wet laboratories and artifact conservation facilities（WETLAB）
information_points.content:
CONS-WETLAB-M78：According to the heritage conservation inspection report for the shipboard wet conservation and desalting laboratory, RV Pelagic Explorer has wet-lab biosecurity clearance, having secured formal sign-off on biological containment and water filtration standards.
CONS-WETLAB-EMV：Based on the heritage conservation inspection report for the shipboard wet conservation and desalting laboratory, RV Oceanus Sentinel does not have wet-lab biosecurity clearance, lacking formal sign-off on biological containment and water filtration standards.
CONS-WETLAB-6SU：The heritage conservation inspection report confirms that RV Thalassa Venture holds wet-lab biosecurity clearance, based on formal sign-off on biological containment and water filtration standards for its shipboard wet conservation and desalting laboratory.

information_points.title: Refrigerated artifact holding（CHILL）
information_points.content:
CONS-CHILL-00Y：The conservation chamber register records a cold-storage stabilization volume of 18 m3 for RV Oceanus Sentinel, representing the net volume cooled to 4 degrees Celsius in its controlled climate storage units on the main deck.
CONS-CHILL-051：The conservation chamber register indicates that RV Pelagic Explorer provides a cold-storage stabilization volume of 30 m3 across its controlled climate storage units on the main deck, measured as net volume cooled to 4 degrees Celsius.
CONS-CHILL-VE2：Per the conservation chamber register for controlled climate storage units on the main deck, RV Thalassa Venture features a cold-storage stabilization volume of 24 m3 cooled to 4 degrees Celsius.
